display.purpose: Every section heading (h2); condensed light, balanced wrap.

lead.purpose: The hero line and the selected unit area; max ~22ch.

headline.purpose: Sub-items (h3): infrastructure rows, 3D steps, plan titles.

numeral.purpose: Floor numbers in the floor stack; tabular lining figures.

body-large.purpose: Section intros, address, form input text.

body.purpose: Running text, spec values, buttons at weight 500.

label.purpose: Spec keys, captions, nav links, field labels, meta lines.

wordmark.purpose: CAPITAL as SVG outlines (wide geometric uppercase, Unbounded 600); nav 8.5rem, hero up to 62rem, footer up to 40rem. Not a font token.

descriptor.purpose: Label size, uppercase, 0.08em, Haze; only directly under the hero wordmark. Not a section label.

gradients.name: fin-night
gradients.purpose: One fin on a night ground (hero uses 0.55).

gradients.name: fin-stone
gradients.purpose: One fin on a stone ground.

gradients.name: sky-day
gradients.purpose: 3D stage sky at the start of the turn.

gradients.name: sky-night
gradients.purpose: 3D stage sky at dusk, cross-faded in by scroll.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All CSS state transitions and the hero entrance.

motion.name: state-slow
motion.purpose: Underline draw, arrow slide, nav show/hide, infra heading dim.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: expo.out, 1.3s, from y 32px opacity 0, once at top 88%
motion.purpose: Section headings and intros on entry (GSAP).

motion.name: reveal-group
motion.purpose: Spec rows entering one after another.

motion.name: fin-grow
motion.value: expo.out, 1.6s (hero 1.8s), scaleY 0 to 1 from top, stagger 0.05-0.06s

motion.name: parallax
motion.purpose: Every full-bleed render; image overscanned by 8-12%.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.value: Lenis duration 1.15, exponential ease; anchor jumps 1.4s

motion.name: gallery-pin
motion.purpose: Vertical scroll drives the gallery strip sideways.

motion.name: model-turn
motion.value: 320vh pinned track (260vh mobile), scrubbed 0-1 progress, cubic ease-out in scene
motion.purpose: 3D model turn, day-to-dusk sky, windows lighting; amber 1px progress line.

motion.name: crossfade
motion.purpose: Infrastructure sticky image and 3D poster-to-canvas swap (canvas 1.2s).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: html.motion never set; Lenis/GSAP/WebGL not loaded
motion.purpose: All scenes render static and complete; movement hovers off.

materials3d.name: frame

components.css: :host{--night-950:#0c1220;--night-900:#121a2e;--stone-50:#f4f0e9;--stone-100:#ece6db;--stone-200:#ddd5c6;--amber:#d6a15c;--amber-strong:#e2b375;--ink-on-stone:#151d33;--ink-on-stone-2:#4a5168;--ink-on-night:#ece6db;--ink-on-night-2:#a7aec0;--rule-on-night:rgb(236 230 219 / 0.16);--rule-on-stone:rgb(21 29 51 / 0.16);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);--font-display:'Alumni Sans','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-text:'Onest',system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-night{position:relative;height:14rem;background:var(--night-900);} .ds-fins{position:absolute;top:0;right:24px;height:12rem;display:flex;gap:0.9rem;align-items:flex-start;} .ds-fins span{width:1px;height:var(--h);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(236 230 219 / 0),rgb(236 230 219 / 0.5));transform-origin:top;animation:ds-fin 1.6s var(--ease-out) both;} .ds-fins span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.05s} .ds-fins span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.1s} .ds-fins span:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.15s} .ds-fins span:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.2s} .ds-fins span:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.25s} .ds-fins span:nth-child(7){animation-delay:.3s} .ds-fins span:nth-child(8){animation-delay:.35s} .ds-fins span:nth-child(9){animation-delay:.4s} @keyframes ds-fin{from{transform:scaleY(0)}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-fins span{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
The building is the grammar. Its vertical crown fins become the page's hairline vertical rules, its floors become the floor stack in the plan picker, and the warm light in its windows at dusk becomes the only accent. Sections alternate between night glass and travertine stone, the facade's two materials.

Density is low and architectural: full-bleed renders, very large condensed light headings set like tall glazing, and information as spec-sheet rows on hairlines rather than cards, icon tiles or stat blocks. Everything is square-cornered. Motion is slow and scrubbed: parallax renders, fins growing from the top edge, a pinned 3D turn where windows light up.

The world refuses the real-estate template of hero, icon-card grid and stat tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds (night glass, travertine) alternating by section; one accent (window-lamp amber).
Condensed light display (Alumni Sans 300) at very large sizes; neutral Cyrillic text face (Onest).
Hairline rules (1px at 16%) as the only dividers; spec-sheet rows instead of cards.
Zero radius everywhere; no shadows on UI.
The vertical fin cluster as the recurring mark.
Slow, scrubbed, expo-out motion; full static fallback under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber marks what the visitor can act on or has chosen: the primary action, the selected unit, progress. Never a section fill, heading colour or decoration.

rules.name: The Bronze-on-Stone Rule
rules.body: On travertine, amber is never text or a thin line; it becomes amber-deep. Amber may still fill a button or selected chip on stone.

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: Each section is night or stone, switching ground, ink, secondary ink and rule together; the night unit sheet inside the stone picker is the one exception.

rules.name: The Tall Glazing Rule
rules.body: Headings are the condensed display at 300 or 400, never bold, never the text face.

rules.name: The Tabular Facts Rule
rules.body: Every factual number uses tabular lining figures.

rules.name: The Descriptor Lockup
rules.body: The only tracked uppercase text is the descriptor under the hero wordmark; it is not a section label style.

rules.name: The Hairline Grid Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px rules, never boxes.

rules.name: The Flat Glass Rule
rules.body: Panels never float; a surface differs by its ground, not by a shadow.

dos: Do alternate night and stone sections, switching ground, ink, secondary ink and rule together.
Do reserve amber for the primary action, the selected unit and progress; use amber-deep for amber text or lines on stone.
Do set section headings in Alumni Sans 300 at Display size with balanced wrapping.
Do present facts as spec-sheet rows on hairlines with tabular figures, and show [ЗАПОЛНИТЬ] for unknowns.
Do keep every corner square and every divider 1px.
Do lead with full-bleed renders with gentle parallax (12-18% travel).
Do use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for state changes (0.3-0.6s) and expo-out reveals (1.1-1.6s, 18-32px), and keep every scene usable with motion off.
donts: Don't build cards, icon tiles or stat tiles; use rows, rules and photography.
Don't round corners or add drop shadows to UI.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or use amber as a section background.
Don't set headings bold or in Onest.
Don't add tracked uppercase labels above headings; the descriptor under the wordmark is the only one.
Don't use plain amber for text, focus rings or thin lines on travertine.
